mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_dictionary WHERE table_name = #{tableName} AND column_name = #{columnName}
SELECT * FROM data_dictionary ORDER BY table_name, column_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_dictionary ( table_name, column_name, logical_name_ko, logical_name_en, data_domain, data_type, description, is_pii, is_required, status ) VALUES ( #{tableName}, #{columnName}, #{logicalNameKo}, #{logicalNameEn}, #{dataDomain}, #{dataType}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{isPii}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{isRequired}, FALSE), COALESCE(#{status},'ACTIVE') )
mapper.update: UPDATE data_dictionary SET logical_name_ko = #{logicalNameKo}, logical_name_en = #{logicalNameEn}, data_domain = #{dataDomain}, data_type = #{dataType}, description = #{description}, is_pii = #{isPii}, is_required = #{isRequired}, status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT table_name, column_name FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name NOT LIKE 'flyway%' AND table_name NOT LIKE 'pg_%' ORDER BY table_name, column_name
SELECT * FROM data_dictionary WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY table_name, column_name
